integrity: All claimed infinite-dimensional conclusions have analytic proofs. A deterministic finite numerical checker is included as corroboration, not independent or infinite-dimensional validation.
scientific_limitations: The result is confined to normalized unweighted analytic Bergman space, symmetric diameter, Hilbert exponent two, and density 1-|t|. The isolated eigenvalue is bounded, not evaluated in closed form. The Andreev 2012 full text was not available for comparison; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: A unique spectral outlier for the Bergman diameter trace
